 Bigg Boss 20: Scout-Love controversy may make it last season for committed persons
 Bigg Boss 20's Scout OP-Love Gill controversy raises questions about committed contestants joining future seasons, as past relationships have faced breakups while others found lasting love on the show.
 Poonam Singh 
 17 Nov 2026 15:24 IST
 Kaashvi Hiranandani, Scout Op, Love Gill
 Bigg Boss has always thrived on relationships, emotional confrontations and unexpected romantic twists. While the reality show has helped some contestants find love and strengthen existing relationships, it has also witnessed breakups, love triangles and public accusations that continued to make headlines long after the cameras stopped rolling.
 Advertisment The ongoing controversy surrounding Bigg Boss 20 contestants Scout OP and Love Gill has once again raised questions about whether committed individuals will think twice before participating in future seasons. With Scout's relationship with Kashvi coming under the spotlight and his growing closeness with Love becoming a talking point, the show has brought private relationships into public scrutiny.
 Also Read: Bigg Boss 20: Salman Khan takes ScoutOP to task over physical fight with Yung DSA, questions his influence on gamers; watch 
 Advertisment Scout OP-Love Gill Controversy Puts Relationships Under Spotlight 
 Scout OP and Love Gill initially shared a bond that was described as a brother-sister relationship. However, their increasingly close interactions, including massage sessions, reportedly raised eyebrows inside and outside the house. The situation escalated when Scout's girlfriend, Kashvi, appeared on the show to express her displeasure.
 The controversy also involves fellow contestant Yung DSA. Both Scout and Yung, who reportedly have committed relationships outside the house, admitted developing feelings for Love. The so-called 'grass incident' and their interactions with her have added another layer to the complicated equation.
 With personal relationships becoming part of the show's entertainment narrative, the experience could make committed contestants cautious about signing up for future seasons.
 Bigg Boss Has Witnessed Relationships Breaking Apart 
 The show has a long history of relationships taking unexpected turns. In Bigg Boss 11, Bandgi Kalra's growing closeness with Puneesh Sharma reportedly strained her relationship with Dennis Nagpal. The couple eventually parted ways, while Bandgi and Puneesh continued their relationship for five years before breaking up in 2023.
 Bigg Boss 17 also witnessed complicated equations involving Isha Malviya, her former boyfriend Abhishek Kumar and Samarth Jurel. Isha and Samarth later separated. Similarly, Asim Riaz and Himanshi Khurana, who fell in love during Bigg Boss 13, ended their relationship in 2023.
 Other couples, including Gauahar Khan-Kushal Tandon, Paras Chhabra-Mahira Sharma and Pavitra Punia-Eijaz Khan, also parted ways after finding romance on the show.
 Also Read: Bigg Boss 20: Gauahar Khan calls out Love Gill for distancing herself from ScoutOP at his lowest, questions her actions 
 When Bigg Boss Became The Beginning Of A Love Story 
 However, the reality show has not always been unkind to relationships. Prince Narula and Yuvika Chaudhary found love in  Bigg Boss 9, later married in 2018 and started a family. Rubina Dilaik and Abhinav Shukla, who entered Bigg Boss 14 when their marriage was facing difficulties, emerged with a stronger bond.
 Jasmin Bhasin and Aly Goni, as well as Tejasswi Prakash and Karan Kundrra, also found love during their respective seasons and continue to be together.
 From testing existing relationships to creating lifelong bonds, Bigg Boss has shown both sides of love. But with controversies like Scout OP and Love Gill's unfolding equation, future contestants in committed relationships may have to consider whether the spotlight is worth the personal cost.
